note: Mirrors the relevant fields of CREATURE_DB in docs/game.js. Not imported — game.js's creature system lives inside its main closure with no exported globals, the same reason docs/js/terrain-preview.js mirrors (rather than imports) game.js's terrain math. aggroRangeTiles/leashRangeTiles/attackRangeTiles are already tile multiples in game.js's own source (e.g. aggroRangePx: TILE * 6.2), copied here as plain tile counts, EXCEPT dabinggi-hound's aggro/leash range: in the real game it's a non-hostile, player-directed whistle companion with no autonomous aggro range of its own, so those two fields are a tools-only estimate (matched to gar-wolf's) for cutscenes that stage it as a fighting defender, like the bundled rescue example. modelWidth/spriteAspect match game.js's makeCreatureEntity (all creature sprites are 1375x600px, modelHeight = modelWidth * 600/1375). Keep this file in sync if CREATURE_DB changes.
